title: 8 Boring Factories That Quietly Make Money in Pakistan (Real Costs)
description:
The factories that quietly make money in Pakistan make things people buy every week. Here are eight of them, from a Rs 14 lakh welding workshop to a Rs 4.3 crore soap unit, with the full project cost from Government of Pakistan (SMEDA) feasibility studies, and how to pick the right one for you.
